queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'AOMEI Backupper' AND publisher = 'AOMEI International Network Limited.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'AOMEI Backupper' AND publisher = 'AOMEI International Network Limited.' AND version_compare(version, '8.4.0.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'aomei backupper standard.exe');
